# `response-media-type-added`

Response media type added

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `response-media-type-added` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Responses ([RULES.md section 6](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A response with a body can return an additional media type.

## Why this default

The server only sends it to clients that ask for it in `Accept`.

## Example

From test case [`response-media-type-added`](../../test/cases/response-media-type-added/): A new response media type.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
                schema:
                  type: object
+             application/xml:
+               schema:
+                 type: object
```

Findings:

- `response-media-type-added` · info · GET /pets

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  response-media-type-added: info
```
